caption:
Lulu plays softball every weekend, and the day after a game her throwing shoulder feels heavy.

A good throw usually starts in the legs and trunk, not just the arm. When the arm does most of the work, the shoulder can tire quickly. Clinical Pilates can help build trunk strength and control so the whole body shares the load.

Hybi's 1-minute routine: side plank on your knees, hold 15-20 seconds, 3 times each side, on non-game days.

Pain when throwing, a weak or dead arm, or no change after two weeks is worth an assessment. Chat to our team at Hybrid Physio. Book online via the link in bio ⚾
